units.source_text: 右近对二女公子说：“亲王如此如此……浮舟小姐真可怜，不知多么痛苦呢！”

en.t: Ukon told the Second Princess, "The Prince has done such-and-such... Poor Lady Ukifune; how terribly she must be suffering!"

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“又是老毛病发作了！

en.t: The Second Princess said, "His old bad habit has flared up again!

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲知道了定然诧怪：认为这是多么轻率而荒唐的行为！

en.t: If Ukifune's mother learns of this, she will surely be shocked and think what a reckless and absurd thing it was to do!

units.source_text: 她回去时还再三地说寄居在此很放心呢。”

en.t: When she went home, she said again and again that she felt at ease leaving her here."
She felt deeply sorry toward Ukifune.

units.source_text: 然而她想：“有什么办法可以制止他呢？

en.t: Yet she thought, "What can possibly be done to stop him?

units.source_text: 他是有这怪癖的人，侍女中稍有姿色的也不肯放过呢。

en.t: He is a man with this strange weakness, and he will not leave alone even a slightly pretty lady-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 但不知他怎么会知道浮舟在这里。”

en.t: But how could he have known that Ukifune was here?"

units.source_text: 她懊恼之极，话也说不出来。

en.t: She was so distressed that she could not even speak.

units.source_text: 右近和另一个叫作少将君的侍女议论：“今天来了许多王公大人，

en.t: Ukon and another lady-in-waiting called Shosho no Kimi discussed it: "Many princes and nobles came today,

units.source_text: 亲王陪他们在正殿里游戏。

en.t: and the Prince was entertaining them in the main hall.

units.source_text: 照往日规例，这些日子他总是很迟才回内室的。

en.t: According to his usual custom, at such times he always returns to the inner rooms very late.

units.source_text: 因此我们都放心地去休息了。

en.t: So we all went off to rest without worrying.

units.source_text: 岂知今天他进来特别早，以致发生此事，如今怎么好呢？

en.t: Who could have known that today he would come in especially early and cause this to happen? What are we to do now?

units.source_text: 那乳母真厉害，她一直守护着浮舟小姐，

en.t: That nurse is truly formidable; she stayed by Lady Ukifune and guarded her the whole time,

units.source_text: 眼睛盯住亲王，几乎想把他赶出去呢！”

en.t: keeping her eyes fixed on the Prince as though she were about to drive him out!"
